row.name: sso_exemptions_tenant_select
row.using: (("sso_exemptions"."tenant_id" = any((select string_to_array(coalesce(current_setting('app.read_tenants', true), ''), ',')::uuid[])::uuid[]) and ("sso_exemptions"."tenant_id" = (select nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) or "sso_exemptions"."tenant_id" = any(array(select "tenant_closure"."descendant_id" from "tenant_closure" where "tenant_closure"."ancestor_id" = (select nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::uuid))))))
